"PREMIER PLAY" has three of three top prizes left and is early in its run. Only a small slice of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, tickets and top prizes are running out at about the same rate.

The numbers for "PREMIER PLAY" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
2414.headline: How far along this game is

2415.body:
"Double The Money" has 209,343 prizes of $10 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $2,000 prize, with two left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

If you play "Double The Money" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
2415.headline: What's actually left to win

2416.body:
The most common win left on "Loaded with $2,000s" is $20. The second biggest prize left is $500, and 1,287 of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

Everything here about "Loaded with $2,000s" comes from official Virginia lottery numbers, current through October 20.
2416.headline: A close look at the prizes

2419.body:
One of Bronze 7s's top prizes was claimed two days ago. A player in Virginia won $2,777. The game started with four top prizes and now has two top prizes. Nothing bigger can change on a scratcher.

Everything here about "Bronze 7s" comes from official Virginia lottery numbers, current through October 20.
2419.headline: Another top prize was claimed

2420.body:
On "Silver 7s", one $177,777 top prize was claimed earlier this week. That leaves two of the original three. The prize table has today's count for every prize level.

Everything here about "Silver 7s" comes from official Virginia lottery numbers, current through October 20.
2420.headline: Fewer $177,777 prizes left

2421.body:
About a quarter of the tickets for "Gold 7s" have been sold. The game is in the middle of its run. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, the top prizes and the tickets are going at about the same pace.

Every line of Gold 7s's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
2421.headline: Early stage or late

2422.body:
"Platinum 7s" has gone close to two months without a top prize claim, and tickets kept selling. Only a fixed number of tickets are printed. About a third of the tickets are sold, and every remaining $2 million prize is still unclaimed. That leaves the same top prizes among fewer tickets.

If you play "Platinum 7s" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
2422.headline: Close to two months, no top prize claimed

Everything here about "HAUNTED HUNDREDS" comes from official Virginia lottery numbers, current through October 20.
